GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mains Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Projectile Motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum Page 12 of 55 1 STRAND 1.0 LIFE SCIENCE Strand Sub Stra and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
